chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Musa ibn Bakr, from al-Zurari, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
The woman who is thrice divorced has no maintenance (nafaqah) from her husband; that is only for the one whose husband has the right of return (raj'ah).

key_terms.الْمُطَلَّقَةُ ثَلَاثًا: The woman who has been thrice divorced

ai.seo_question: Does a woman receive financial support after a triple divorce in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: In al-Istibsar, Shaykh al-Tusi records this ruling from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) to clarify that a triple divorce constitutes an irrevocable dissolution (talaq ba'in), thereby terminating the husband's obligation for maintenance (nafaqah) and housing (sukna). This contrasts with a revocable divorce (raj'ah), where the marital bond remains intact and financial support continues until the waiting period expires, highlighting the distinct legal consequences of divorce types in Shia jurisprudence.
